programme.title: Nat King Cole: Afraid Of The Dark
programme.desc: At a time when black Americans were still suffering segregation and prejudice, Nat King Cole broke through the race barrier, becoming the only black television star in The US, with a weekly primetime show acknowledging his unique natural talent. Through extensive archives and his private journals, together with exclusive interviews with his widow, Maria Cole, and other family members, the true story is told of the man whose charm and genius for performance made him a role model and a pinnacle of American cultural society. Fellow artists George Benson, Harry Belafonte, Johnny Mathis and Tony Bennett, among many others, provide the anecdotes of this pioneering artist who crossed the colour barrier, appealing to white and black audiences in equal measure. programme.title: Nat King Cole: Afraid Of The Dark
programme.desc: At a time when black Americans were still suffering segregation and prejudice, Nat King Cole broke through the race barrier, becoming the only black television star in The US, with a weekly primetime show acknowledging his unique natural talent. Through extensive archives and his private journals, together with exclusive interviews with his widow, Maria Cole, and other family members, the true story is told of the man whose charm and genius for performance made him a role model and a pinnacle of American cultural society. Fellow artists George Benson, Harry Belafonte, Johnny Mathis and Tony Bennett, among many others, provide the anecdotes of this pioneering artist who crossed the colour barrier, appealing to white and black audiences in equal measure. programme.desc: A London cinema owner hides a deadly secret as part of a terrorist ring. When suspicion grows around him, his wife and a detective close in - unaware he's using her young brother to deliver bombs.

programme.title: Dirty Dancing
programme.desc: Spending the summer at a Catskills resort with her family, Frances "Baby" Houseman falls in love with the camp's dance instructor, Johnny Castle (Patrick Swayze).

programme.title: Oskars Kleid
programme.desc: When Ben's son decides to live as a girl from now on, his world is turned upside down and the relationship with his family is put to a severe test.

programme.title: What We Did On Our Holiday
programme.desc: Doug and Abi take their kids on a family holiday. Surrounded by relatives, the kids innocently reveal the ins and outs of their family life and many intimate details about their parents. It's soon clear that when it comes to keeping a big secret under wraps from the rest of the family, their children are their biggest liability. Stars David Tennant and Rosamund Pike.

programme.title: The Scarlet And The Black
programme.desc: Based on the humanitarian works of Irish-born Vatican priest Monsignor Hugh O'Flaherty, who saved thousands of escaped prisoners of war, Jews and Italian Resistance families in occupied Rome during the World War Two, by hiding them in the church. Directed by Jerry London and stars Gregory Peck, Christopher Plummer and John Gielgud.

programme.title: A Hard Day's Night
programme.desc: An anarchic and offbeat story of thirty-six hours in the lives of the Beatles as they travel from Liverpool to London to perform on a TV show. However, things take a dramatic turn as they realise that their drummer, Ringo, has gone missing. Director Richard Lester uses a variety of cinematographic styles including documentary, surrealism and neo-realism to create one of the milestone pictures of the 1960s.

programme.title: Good Morning, Vietnam
programme.desc: In 1965 Saigon, irreverent radio DJ Adrian Cronauer shakes up Armed Forces Radio with his wild humour, clashing with military censors while confronting the realities of the Vietnam War.

programme.title: The Salamander
programme.desc: After her father's death, 40-year-old Catherine escapes to Brazil, where a fling with a young man turns into a passionate affair - forcing her to confront desire, freedom, and tough choices.

programme.title: The Salamander
programme.desc: After her father's death, 40-year-old Catherine escapes to Brazil, where a fling with a young man turns into a passionate affair - forcing her to confront desire, freedom, and tough choices.

programme.title: Sisu
programme.desc: Deep in the Lapland wilderness during the final days of World War II, a solitary prospector strikes gold and sets out on a perilous journey to cash in his find. When a retreating Nazi unit attempts to steal his fortune, they discover they have targeted a man of extraordinary resilience. What follows is a brutal, darkly entertaining battle of survival, revenge and determination against impossible odds.

programme.title: The Promised Land
programme.desc: Impoverished Captain Ludvig Kahlen tries to tame Denmark's brutal heath to earn a royal name, defying cruel landowner de Schinkel, who seeks revenge as Kahlen shelters runaways and protects his new family.

programme.title: The Loss Of A Teardrop Diamond
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Mississippi, this film follows the tumultuous romance between a rebellious socialite and the handsome young man she hires as her escort.

programme.title: A Hard Day's Night
programme.desc: An anarchic and offbeat story of thirty-six hours in the lives of the Beatles as they travel from Liverpool to London to perform on a TV show. However, things take a dramatic turn as they realise that their drummer, Ringo, has gone missing. Director Richard Lester uses a variety of cinematographic styles including documentary, surrealism and neo-realism to create one of the milestone pictures of the 1960s.

programme.title: aka The Choir : Boychoir
programme.desc: A troubled but talented eleven-year-old boy at a prestigious East Coast music school clashes with the school's demanding choir master (Dustin Hoffman), in this inspiring drama co-starring Kathy Bates, Josh Lucas, Debra Winger, and Glee's Kevin McHale. From acclaimed Canadian director Francois Girard (The Red Violin) comes a drama that the entire family can enjoy.

programme.title: The Lady in the Van
programme.desc: Alan Bennett's story is based on the true story of Miss Shepherd (Maggie Smith), a woman of uncertain origins who 'temporarily' parks her van in Bennett's London driveway and proceeds to live there for 15 years. What begins as a begrudging favour becomes a relationship that will change both their lives. Directed by Nicholas Hytner and also stars Alex Jennings, Jim Broadbent and Claire Foy.

programme.title: Dangerous Liaisons
programme.desc: In 18th century France, the Marquise de Merteuil and the Vicomte de Valmont play a dangerous game of seduction.

programme.title: Sabotage
programme.desc: A London cinema owner hides a deadly secret as part of a terrorist ring. When suspicion grows around him, his wife and a detective close in - unaware he's using her young brother to deliver bombs.

programme.title: Made In England: Powell & Pressburger
programme.desc: Martin Scorsese reflects on the influence of filmmakers Michael Powell and Emeric Pressburger.

programme.title: One Of Our Aircraft Is Missing
programme.desc: On its way back from a raid on the city of Stuttgart, Germany, a British bomber is shot down over Nazi-held Holland. Parachuting into Dutch farmlands under cover of darkness, the six-member crew connects with members of the local resistance, who shelter the Brits from their Nazi inquisitors as they make their way towards freedom.

programme.title: Cold Pursuit
programme.desc: After his son's death is dismissed as a drug overdose, respected snowplough driver Nels Coxman (Liam Neeson) uncovers a brutal crime that reaches into a powerful mountain drug syndicate. Armed with little more than determination and a hunting rifle, he begins targeting those responsible one by one. As bodies mount, rival gangs prepare for war, drawing Nels into an escalating cycle of violence across a frozen Colorado landscape.

programme.title: Only the Brave
programme.desc: Only the Brave tells the true story of the Granite Mountain Hotshots, a fearless team of firefighters who risk everything to protect others, forging a deep brotherhood tested by a deadly wildfire.

programme.title: Mary Makes It Easy
programme.desc: Mary's straightforward bread recipes are all you knead: biscuits, buns, thick focaccia pizza, and a classic loaf.

programme.title: Outback Gourmet
programme.desc: Justine travels from Darwin to Alice Springs. She joins Chef Bob Taylor for a cultural tour of Sampson’s Gap and later prepares a quick Spaghetti dish at ANZAC Hill.

programme.title: Girls Guide:hunting Fishing Wild Cooking
programme.desc: Enjoying the bounty of Autumn, Analiese harvests blackberries and spins the first of her honey from the beehive. She has also got her gun licence, and goes on her first hunt for venison, and later takes her mentor, Peter Gilmore, foraging for wild mushrooms.

programme.title: High Country Farm
programme.desc: Carlos expands his flock of sheep significantly with a huge purchase at a southern sheep auction, but what he doesn't know is the district is about to get hit by a drought.

programme.title: Jamie's Comfort Food
programme.sub-title: Jerk Ham With Egg And Chips, Chocolate Nougat Cake And Chicken Kebab
programme.desc: This episode sees Jamie take a British cafe favourite (ham, egg and chips) and give it a wonderful Jamaican twist with a hit of fiery jerk marinade. Next, Jamie cooks up a simple, but incredibly elegant pasta dish, loaded with beautiful crab meat, wafer-thin fennel and a hit of chilli to bring everything together.

programme.title: Cheese Slices

programme.desc: At a time when black Americans were still suffering segregation and prejudice, Nat King Cole broke through the race barrier, becoming the only black television star in The US, with a weekly primetime show acknowledging his unique natural talent. Through extensive archives and his private journals, together with exclusive interviews with his widow, Maria Cole, and other family members, the true story is told of the man whose charm and genius for performance made him a role model and a pinnacle of American cultural society. Fellow artists George Benson, Harry Belafonte, Johnny Mathis and Tony Bennett, among many others, provide the anecdotes of this pioneering artist who crossed the colour barrier, appealing to white and black audiences in equal measure. programme.desc: Considered to be one of the finest British films ever made, The Life and Death of Colonel Blimp is a stirring masterpiece detailing the experiences of a British officer, Clive Candy (Roger Livesey), through the trials and tribulations of his army career from 1902 to 1942. Anton Walbrook and Deborah Kerr provide unforgettable support, he as a German enemy turned lifelong friend of Candy's and she as young women of three consecutive generations.

programme.title: Sabotage
programme.desc: A London cinema owner hides a deadly secret as part of a terrorist ring. When suspicion grows around him, his wife and a detective close in - unaware he's using her young brother to deliver bombs.

programme.title: Dirty Dancing
programme.desc: Spending the summer at a Catskills resort with her family, Frances "Baby" Houseman falls in love with the camp's dance instructor, Johnny Castle (Patrick Swayze).

programme.title: Oskars Kleid
programme.desc: When Ben's son decides to live as a girl from now on, his world is turned upside down and the relationship with his family is put to a severe test.

programme.title: What We Did On Our Holiday
programme.desc: Doug and Abi take their kids on a family holiday. Surrounded by relatives, the kids innocently reveal the ins and outs of their family life and many intimate details about their parents. It's soon clear that when it comes to keeping a big secret under wraps from the rest of the family, their children are their biggest liability. Stars David Tennant and Rosamund Pike.

programme.title: The Scarlet And The Black
programme.desc: Based on the humanitarian works of Irish-born Vatican priest Monsignor Hugh O'Flaherty, who saved thousands of escaped prisoners of war, Jews and Italian Resistance families in occupied Rome during the World War Two, by hiding them in the church. Directed by Jerry London and stars Gregory Peck, Christopher Plummer and John Gielgud.

programme.title: A Hard Day's Night
programme.desc: An anarchic and offbeat story of thirty-six hours in the lives of the Beatles as they travel from Liverpool to London to perform on a TV show. However, things take a dramatic turn as they realise that their drummer, Ringo, has gone missing. Director Richard Lester uses a variety of cinematographic styles including documentary, surrealism and neo-realism to create one of the milestone pictures of the 1960s.

programme.title: Good Morning, Vietnam
programme.desc: In 1965 Saigon, irreverent radio DJ Adrian Cronauer shakes up Armed Forces Radio with his wild humour, clashing with military censors while confronting the realities of the Vietnam War.

programme.title: The Salamander
programme.desc: After her father's death, 40-year-old Catherine escapes to Brazil, where a fling with a young man turns into a passionate affair - forcing her to confront desire, freedom, and tough choices.

programme.title: The Salamander
programme.desc: After her father's death, 40-year-old Catherine escapes to Brazil, where a fling with a young man turns into a passionate affair - forcing her to confront desire, freedom, and tough choices.

programme.title: Sisu
programme.desc: Deep in the Lapland wilderness during the final days of World War II, a solitary prospector strikes gold and sets out on a perilous journey to cash in his find. When a retreating Nazi unit attempts to steal his fortune, they discover they have targeted a man of extraordinary resilience. What follows is a brutal, darkly entertaining battle of survival, revenge and determination against impossible odds.

programme.title: The Promised Land
programme.desc: Impoverished Captain Ludvig Kahlen tries to tame Denmark's brutal heath to earn a royal name, defying cruel landowner de Schinkel, who seeks revenge as Kahlen shelters runaways and protects his new family.

programme.title: The Loss Of A Teardrop Diamond
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Mississippi, this film follows the tumultuous romance between a rebellious socialite and the handsome young man she hires as her escort.

programme.title: A Hard Day's Night

However, things take a dramatic turn as they realise that their drummer, Ringo, has gone missing. Director Richard Lester uses a variety of cinematographic styles including documentary, surrealism and neo-realism to create one of the milestone pictures of the 1960s.

programme.title: aka The Choir : Boychoir
programme.desc: A troubled but talented eleven-year-old boy at a prestigious East Coast music school clashes with the school's demanding choir master (Dustin Hoffman), in this inspiring drama co-starring Kathy Bates, Josh Lucas, Debra Winger, and Glee's Kevin McHale. From acclaimed Canadian director Francois Girard (The Red Violin) comes a drama that the entire family can enjoy.

programme.title: The Lady in the Van
programme.desc: Alan Bennett's story is based on the true story of Miss Shepherd (Maggie Smith), a woman of uncertain origins who 'temporarily' parks her van in Bennett's London driveway and proceeds to live there for 15 years. What begins as a begrudging favour becomes a relationship that will change both their lives. Directed by Nicholas Hytner and also stars Alex Jennings, Jim Broadbent and Claire Foy.

programme.title: Dangerous Liaisons
programme.desc: In 18th century France, the Marquise de Merteuil and the Vicomte de Valmont play a dangerous game of seduction.

programme.title: Sabotage
programme.desc: A London cinema owner hides a deadly secret as part of a terrorist ring. When suspicion grows around him, his wife and a detective close in - unaware he's using her young brother to deliver bombs.

programme.title: Made In England: Powell & Pressburger
programme.desc: Martin Scorsese reflects on the influence of filmmakers Michael Powell and Emeric Pressburger.

programme.title: One Of Our Aircraft Is Missing
programme.desc: On its way back from a raid on the city of Stuttgart, Germany, a British bomber is shot down over Nazi-held Holland. Parachuting into Dutch farmlands under cover of darkness, the six-member crew connects with members of the local resistance, who shelter the Brits from their Nazi inquisitors as they make their way towards freedom.

programme.title: Cold Pursuit
programme.desc: After his son's death is dismissed as a drug overdose, respected snowplough driver Nels Coxman (Liam Neeson) uncovers a brutal crime that reaches into a powerful mountain drug syndicate. Armed with little more than determination and a hunting rifle, he begins targeting those responsible one by one. As bodies mount, rival gangs prepare for war, drawing Nels into an escalating cycle of violence across a frozen Colorado landscape.

programme.title: Only the Brave
programme.desc: Only the Brave tells the true story of the Granite Mountain Hotshots, a fearless team of firefighters who risk everything to protect others, forging a deep brotherhood tested by a deadly wildfire.

programme.title: Mary Makes It Easy
programme.desc: Mary's straightforward bread recipes are all you knead: biscuits, buns, thick focaccia pizza, and a classic loaf.

programme.title: Outback Gourmet
programme.desc: Justine travels from Darwin to Alice Springs. She joins Chef Bob Taylor for a cultural tour of Sampson’s Gap and later prepares a quick Spaghetti dish at ANZAC Hill.

programme.title: Girls Guide:hunting Fishing Wild Cooking
programme.desc: Enjoying the bounty of Autumn, Analiese harvests blackberries and spins the first of her honey from the beehive. She has also got her gun licence, and goes on her first hunt for venison, and later takes her mentor, Peter Gilmore, foraging for wild mushrooms.

programme.title: High Country Farm
programme.desc: Carlos expands his flock of sheep significantly with a huge purchase at a southern sheep auction, but what he doesn't know is the district is about to get hit by a drought.

programme.title: Jamie's Comfort Food
programme.sub-title: Jerk Ham With Egg And Chips, Chocolate Nougat Cake And Chicken Kebab
programme.desc: This episode sees Jamie take a British cafe favourite (ham, egg and chips) and give it a wonderful Jamaican twist with a hit of fiery jerk marinade. programme.desc: At a time when black Americans were still suffering segregation and prejudice, Nat King Cole broke through the race barrier, becoming the only black television star in The US, with a weekly primetime show acknowledging his unique natural talent. Fellow artists George Benson, Harry Belafonte, Johnny Mathis and Tony Bennett, among many others, provide the anecdotes of this pioneering artist who crossed the colour barrier, appealing to white and black audiences in equal measure. programme.title: Dinosaur With Stephen Fry

He also glimpses this magnificent creature's softer side.

programme.title: Icons Of Auto

Fellow artists George Benson, Harry Belafonte, Johnny Mathis and Tony Bennett, among many others, provide the anecdotes of this pioneering artist who crossed the colour barrier, appealing to white and black audiences in equal measure.
